versos.hebraico: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל־תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
controles.kjv: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
controles.livre: Filho meu, não te esqueças de minha lei; e que teu coração guarde meus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: for length of days, and years of life, and peace, will they add to you.
controles.kjv: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
controles.livre: Porque te acrescentarão extensão de dias, e anos de vida e paz.

versos.hebraico: חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל־יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
controles.kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
controles.livre: Que a bondade e a fidelidade não te desamparem; amarra-as junto ao teu pescoço; escreve-as na tábua de teu coração.

versos.hebraico: וּמְצָא־חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל־ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם׃פ

controles.web: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
controles.kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
controles.livre: Então tu acharás graça e bom entendimento, aos olhos de Deus e dos homens.

versos.hebraico: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל־בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃

controles.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
controles.kjv: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
controles.livre: Confia no SENHOR com todo o teu coração; e não te apoies em teu próprio entendimento.

versos.hebraico: בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
controles.kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
controles.livre: Dá reconhecimento a ele em todas os teus caminhos; e ele endireitará tuas veredas.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃

controles.web: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
controles.kjv: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.
controles.livre: Não sejas sábio aos teus próprios olhos; teme ao SENHOR, e afasta-te do mal.

versos.hebraico: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
controles.kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
controles.livre: Isto será remédio para teu corpo, e alívio para teus ossos.

versos.hebraico: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת־יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל־תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
controles.kjv: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
controles.livre: Honra ao SENHOR com teus bens, e com a primeira parte de toda a tua renda.

versos.hebraico: וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃פ

controles.web: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
controles.kjv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
controles.livre: E teus celeiros se encherão de fartura, e teus tanques transbordarão de vinho novo.

versos.hebraico: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל־תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל־תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his reproof:
controles.kjv: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:
controles.livre: Filho meu, não rejeites a correção do SENHOR, nem te desagrades de sua repreensão;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת־בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה׃

controles.web: for whom Yahweh loves, he reproves; even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
controles.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR repreende a quem ele ama, assim como o pai ao filho, a quem ele quer bem.

versos.hebraico: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה׃

controles.web: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
controles.kjv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
controles.livre: Bem-aventurado o homem que encontra sabedoria, e o homem que ganha conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
controles.kjv: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
controles.livre: Porque seu produto é melhor que o produto da prata; e seu valor, mais do que o do ouro fino.

versos.hebraico: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מפניים וְכָל־חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
controles.kjv: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
controles.livre: Ela é mais preciosa do que rubis; e tudo o que podes desejar não se pode comparar a ela.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
controles.kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
controles.livre: Extensão de dias há em sua mão direita; em sua esquerda riquezas e honra.

versos.hebraico: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל־נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
controles.kjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
controles.livre: Seus caminhos são caminhos agradáveis; e todas as suas veredas são paz.

versos.hebraico: עֵץ־חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃פ

controles.web: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
controles.kjv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
controles.livre: Ela é uma árvore de vida para os que dela pegam; e bem-aventurados são todos os que a retêm.

versos.hebraico: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד־אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃

controles.web: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
controles.kjv: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
controles.livre: O SENHOR com sabedoria fundou a terra; ele preparou os céus com a inteligência.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ־טָֽל׃

controles.web: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
controles.kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
controles.livre: Com seu conhecimento se fenderam os abismos, e as nuvens gotejam orvalho.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭נִי אַל־יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃

controles.web: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
controles.kjv: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
controles.livre: Filho meu, que estes não se afastem de teus olhos; guarda a sabedoria e o bom-senso.

versos.hebraico: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
controles.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
controles.livre: Porque serão vida para tua alma, e graça para teu pescoço.

versos.hebraico: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף׃

controles.web: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
controles.kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
controles.livre: Então andarás por teu caminho em segurança; e com teus pés não tropeçarás.

versos.hebraico: אִם־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא־תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
controles.kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
controles.livre: Quando te deitares, não terás medo; tu deitarás, e teu sono será suave.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא׃

controles.web: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes:
controles.kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
controles.livre: Não temas o pavor repentino; nem da assolação dos perversos, quando vier.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד׃

controles.web: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
controles.kjv: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR será tua esperança; e ele guardará teus pés para que não sejam presos.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּמְנַע־ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל ידיך לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

controles.web: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
controles.kjv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
controles.livre: Não detenhas o bem daqueles que possuem o direito, se tiveres em tuas mãos poder para o fazeres.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לרעיך׀ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
controles.kjv: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
controles.livre: Não digas a teu próximo: Vai, e volta depois , que amanhã te darei; se tu tiveres contigo o que ele te pede .

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל־רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא־יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
controles.kjv: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
controles.livre: Não planejes o mal contra teu próximo, pois ele mora tendo confiança em ti.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תרוב עִם־אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם־לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה׃

controles.web: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
controles.kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
controles.livre: Não brigues contra alguém sem motivo, se ele não fez mal contra ti.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל־תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל־דְּרָכָֽיו׃

controles.web: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
controles.kjv: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
controles.livre: Não tenhas inveja do homem violento, nem escolhas seguir algum dos caminhos dele.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת־יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
controles.kjv: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR abomina os perversos; mas ele guarda o seu segredo com os justos.

versos.hebraico: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
controles.kjv: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
controles.livre: A maldição do SENHOR está na casa do perverso; porém ele abençoa a morada dos justos.

versos.hebraico: אִם־לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא־יָלִ֑יץ ולעניים יִתֶּן־חֵֽן׃

controles.web: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
controles.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
controles.livre: Certamente ele zombará dos zombadores; mas dará graça aos humildes.

versos.hebraico: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן׃פ

controles.web: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
controles.kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
controles.livre: Os sábios herdarão honra; porém os loucos terão sobre si confusão.
